data_type: SYNTHETIC; actual C controller and command codec; motor-CAN feedback quantization

plan.scope: Pitch-only ESO parameter experiment; preserve native GM6020 CAN quantization, paired angle/RPM packet delivery, all LQR/Ki gains, gravity, actuator model and limits. No IMU assumptions or firmware parameter adoption.
plan.selection: Among development-eligible candidates, minimize the worst case mean paired RMSE change, then primary mean paired RMSE change, then candidate ID. Freeze the winner before opening fresh holdout seeds; do not fall back to another candidate after holdout failure.
plan.interpretation: This is tuning versus the current new-C gravity-on configuration. It does not replace the original same-Ki / gravity-off acceptance or establish hardware improvement. All rejected candidates remain in the report.
